metadata.title: The anisotropic Michael-Simon inequality
metadata.abstract: We prove a Michael-Simon inequality for varifolds of every dimension and codimension with respect to anisotropic energies. Combined with Allard's anisotropic regularity theorem, this result yields the regularity of hypersurfaces with bounded anisotropic mean curvature in every dimension. Using the results of De Philippis and Pigati, it also implies density bounds and compactness properties for rectifiable varifolds with uniformly bounded anisotropic first variation. The proof relies on a projection method for anisotropic stress measures as well as the recent resolution of the vanishing mass conjecture by Gennaioli and Rindler.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 为任意维数、任意余维且带各向异性能量的 varifold 证明 Michael--Simon 不等式。
analysis.breakthrough: 结合近期消失质量猜想的解决，得到有界各向异性平均曲率超曲面的全维正则性、密度界与紧性。
analysis.limitations: 正则性应用仍需 Allard 型小量条件；一般余维中的完整几何后果有待展开。
